n, k = map(int, input().split())
p = list(map(float, input().split()))

ans = [0.0] * n
dp = [0.0] * (1 << n)
sum_mask = [0.0] * (1 << n)

def count_bits(x):
    cnt = 0
    while x:
        cnt += x & 1
        x >>= 1
    return cnt

for mask in range(1 << n):
    s = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        if mask & (1 << i):
            s += p[i]
    sum_mask[mask] = s

dp[0] = 1.0
flag = 0

for mask in range(1 << n):
    bits_count = count_bits(mask)
    if bits_count > k:
        continue
    if dp[mask] < 1e-100:
        continue
    if bits_count == k:
        flag = 1
    rem_sum = 1.0 - sum_mask[mask]
    if rem_sum < 1e-6:
        continue
    for i in range(n):
        if mask & (1 << i):
            continue
        move_prob = dp[mask] * p[i] / rem_sum
        dp[mask | (1 << i)] += move_prob

if flag == 0:
    for i in range(n):
        ans[i] = 0.0 if p[i] < 1e-6 else 1.0
else:
    for mask in range(1 << n):
        if count_bits(mask) == k:
            for i in range(n):
                if mask & (1 << i):
                    ans[i] += dp[mask]

print(" ".join(f"{x:.12f}" for x in ans))
